name: System Shock 2

steam.store_details: The classic 1999 build was delisted from Steam in October 2025; Steam now sells only the 25th Anniversary Remaster, a separate ground-up rewrite with no DirectSound3D EAX support.
steam.patches: The System Shock 2 Community Patch (SCP) is worth pairing, though it's general bugfix/polish, not audio-specific.

gog.store_details: The original 1999 build's own GOG listing was delisted in October 2025 — GOG now sells only the 25th Anniversary Remaster, a separate ground-up rewrite with no DirectSound3D EAX support — but existing owners of the classic build keep access.
gog.patches: The System Shock 2 Community Patch (SCP) is worth pairing, though it's general bugfix/polish, not audio-specific.

audio_fixes.title: Enable underwater reverb
audio_fixes.reason: Some System Shock 2 maps don't mark their underwater areas, so they play the wrong reverb there (per NewDark's documentation).

extra_fixes.title: Enable full-precision mouse look
extra_fixes.reason: System Shock 2 reads mouse look through standard Windows input by default, which doesn't give high-resolution mice their full precision (per NewDark's documentation).

notes: It comes with NewDark pre-installed, which has its own OpenAL Soft 'Hardware Acceleration' option in the in-game Audio menu — worth trying if EAX doesn't sound right.
